There's a secret message… before everything you type.
Welcome to Agent School — lesson seven.
Yesterday you learned to write great prompts.
Today: the prompt you never see.
Every AI app sends a hidden first message called the system prompt.
It tells the model who to be and what rules to follow — before you say a word.
"You are a helpful support agent for this company.
Same model, different system prompt… and you get a tutor, a lawyer-style assistant, or a pirate.
For builders, this is where you put the personality, the rules, and the boundaries of your agent.
But it's guidance, not a lock.
Clever users can try to talk around it.
We'll fight that in lesson twenty-one.
Remember: the system prompt is the job description you give your AI.
